### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the Mistral seed-handling and request-option preservation changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes Mistral request argument handling so zero-valued seeds are sent correctly and caller-provided request options are preserved. **Changes:** - Translate every non-`None` integer seed, including `0`, into `random_seed`. - Merge `random_seed` into a copy of the caller’s `extra_body` instead of replacing it. - Add regression tests for both cases and document the fixes. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​test_provider_mistral.py` | Adds request-argument tests for zero seeds and preservation of `extra_body`. | | `chatlas/​_provider_mistral.py` | Fixes seed handling and preserves additional request-body fields. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Documents both Mistral fixes. |
Review effort: Balanced
